title: Honoré de Balzac's birth chart
metaDescription: Honoré de Balzac's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 29.4° Taurus. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Venus and Pluto sit 0.0° from an exact trine — near enough that the tradition reads taste and depth as a single working part. A trine runs downhill — the talent that never announces itself because it never had to.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's exact place is 29.4° Taurus. That falls in the third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Saturn in the classical scheme — a earth sign read through a fixed season.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 11.9° Taurus, Venus was at 3.1° Cancer, Mars was at 8.0° Cancer. Read together: a mind that trusts the measured and the checked; taste tuned to mood and undertow; drive that moves on certainty and current.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Venus and Pluto: 0.0° from an exact trine. Trines are read as inheritance rather than achievement: the ease is genuine, and nothing about it was earned. Behind it, Mercury opposition Neptune at 1.4°, and Jupiter square Pluto at 3.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Three planets here sit in a sign the classical scheme scores. Mars in Cancer at 8.0° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Jupiter in Gemini at 6.6° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Saturn in Cancer at 22.4° is in detriment. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 5 water, 3 earth, 1 fire, 1 air; by modality, 4 mutable, 3 fixed, 3 cardinal. Water weights a chart toward the felt and the remembered — information that arrives as atmosphere before it arrives as words. Uranus and Neptune were retrograde. Mercury changed direction during the day, so its motion is left open.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Sagittarius for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 14.5° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 15.4°.
